limitations: Availability is VP plus declared construction filters, not independent certification of every gold variant.
All accepted family/recipe/tense/voice cells have all nine person-number options. Grouped cyclic assignment proves balanced person-number supply with no membership fixed.
No final distribution or membership has been frozen; old test suballocation is unchanged.
Within-family correlations are illustrative sensitivity assumptions, not measured model statistics.
No held-out model answers were inspected and no paid calls were made.

grammar_filters.intensive_lexical_scope: Consonant-initial normalized root with exactly one vowel; no Curadi, roch or shobh; semantic conditions inherent in the traditional intensive operation.
grammar_filters.passive_scope: Causal recipes only, in Lat, Lan, Lot, VidhiLin, Lut and Lrt.

independent_precision_thresholds.explanation: The nominal 1,601 threshold uses exactly p = .80. At p = .79, the larger Bernoulli variance needs at least 1,660 independent questions. Dependence can require more.

recommended_capacity_tradeoff.status: Proposal only; not frozen sampling or membership.
recommended_capacity_tradeoff.reason: Keeps all ten classes and broad tense/recipe coverage while reducing repeat-family dependence relative to exact pilot class weights.

split_policy.legacy_500_500_suballocation: Unchanged by worker; coordinator may supersede it before final exposure.

source_evidence.nested_composition_limits: jF/JF short-i ordering and lih vowel preservation are source-supported inference or analogy, not direct examples of those complete forms. Nested passive licensing is compositional; the direct examples do not certify every complete nested passive chain.

completion_limits: No strongest-reference 79–81% benchmark established. Opus completed accuracy is 85.22%; Astra is unmeasured.
Final task membership, RL examples and reference evaluation remain outstanding.
Mechanical feasibility is not independent grammatical certification.
1,601 tasks barely meets the independent-binomial precision threshold at exactly 80%; positive family correlation can invalidate that threshold.
No new paid request should execute before the coordinator resolves the documented oracle scope.
